name: shadcn/ui
summary: Open-source React/Next UI primitives (Tailwind) installed via the shadcn registry CLI.
gaps: Pilot includes 11 free registry:ui primitives of ~54 new-york registry:ui items (~363 total registry items including examples/blocks); not a full inventory.
Library adapter prefers dynamic-import per ARCHITECTURE §5 but component demos use iframe→docs until Build smoke-certifies dynamic-import mounts.
Official docs often show `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add …`; catalog uses portable `npx shadcn@latest` equivalent from the same CLI docs.
Docs URLs `/docs/components/{slug}` currently 307-redirect to `/docs/components/base/{slug}` (Base UI style path); iframeSrc keeps the short canonical path.
`form` exists in registry (`/r/styles/new-york/form.json`) but `/docs/components/form` 308-redirects to `/docs/forms` hub — excluded from this verified set to keep demo==component docs.
`sonner` remains a separate registry:ui item; live `/docs/components/sonner` and `/toast` both resolve to the Toast docs using `add toast` — catalogued under slug `toast` only.
Per-component registry JSON is style-scoped (`/r/styles/new-york/{slug}.json`); projects may use new-york-v4 or other styles after init.

components.name: Button
components.summary: Displays a button or a component that looks like a button.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add button

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"

<Button variant="outline">Button</Button>

copyPrompt.text: Use shadcn/ui free component `Button` (slug `button`) from https://ui.shadcn.com/docs/components/button. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add button` after `npx shadcn@latest init` in a React/Next + Tailwind project. Registry item: https://ui.shadcn.com/r/styles/new-york/button.json. Import from `@/components/ui/button` after CLI add (path may follow project aliases). This component is on the free open-source shadcn/ui registry (MIT; https://github.com/shadcn-ui/ui/blob/main/LICENSE.md). Requires React + Tailwind; many items also pull Radix UI (or Base UI) primitives via the CLI. Prefer free registry only.

components.name: Dialog

import {

components.name: Select
components.summary: Displays a list of options for the user to pick from—triggered by a button.
components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add select

import {
  Select,
  SelectContent,
  SelectGroup,
  SelectItem,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
} from "@/components/ui/select"

const items = [
  { label: "Light", value: "light" },
  { label: "Dark", value: "dark" },
  { label: "System", value: "system" },
]

<Select items={items}>
  <SelectTrigger className="w-[180px]">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Theme" />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectGroup>
      {items.map((item) => (
        <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>
          {item.label}
        </SelectItem>
      ))}
    </SelectGroup>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
